alex: Tiny game: pick one "office-GPT" persona for a coworker and one-line reason. I'll start. StickyNoteGPT  - leaves existential reminders on your monitor: 'Do the thing? Maybe.' :memo:
priya: BadgeGPT - only talks in access levels. Very passive: 'You are level: coffee.' :id:
noah: StandupGPT - insists on 3 bullets even if nothing happened. Auto-scrum, slightly smug. :spiral_calendar:
kim: ThermostatGPT - negotiates workplace feelings by 2 degrees. Very hot takes. :thermometer:
zane: SlackbotGPT - offers pithy reactions, archives jokes, randomly threads memes as 'announcements'. :robot_face:
priya: also OpenDeskGPT - suggests better chair positions and cites ergonomics papers. low-key helpful. :chair:
alex: code: ```# if you hear a sigh, ping StandupGPT
call_standup() -> "One blocker: laundry espresso."``` :coffee:
noah: can we have a 'decommission' command for ThermostatGPT during summer? :sweat_drops:
kim: vote by reacting with the emoji you nominated. ops-bot: Poll created by alex - react to vote. :white_check_mark:
zane: request: StickyNoteGPT should have a 'sorry' sticker mode for when it oversteps. :pleading_face:
priya: Also we need a tiny sticker set. anyone good at pixel art? :art:
alex: if StandupGPT wins I will write an addendum: it has a secret sonnet mode at 8am. :book:
